## Locked-covariate gaps — project-recorded decisions (dated 2026-06-19; timing limitation applies)

Supplementary Data 1 does not fully supply 3 historically locked covariates. The project record documents the following resolutions, but git history does not independently establish that they preceded every model fit. The executed analysis uses no silent imputation:

1. **`Water_temp_oC` is 100% NA (755/755)** → **RESOLVED: substitute `temp_monthly_average`** (54 NA, all E14) — the column the authors actually used. Carried in `conwy_covariates.tsv`; prereg detection model updated.
2. **`week_before_flow_by_catchment`: 108 NA** (and daily/monthly/seasonal flow) — by site {'E13': 54, 'E14': 54}: only the two lowest sites **E13, E14**. → **RESOLVED: use the on-hand `Catchment_flow_m3_s`** for these sites (carried in `conwy_covariates.tsv`) — a per-timepoint catchment series (18 distinct values, ~2.53–57.64 m³/s, constant across sites at each timepoint; 2.53 is only T01), *not* a single scalar.
3. **Site E14 (Trefriw)** has NA `river_gradient_percent` (54, by site {'E14': 54}), `temp_monthly_average`, and `rainfall_monthly_average`, and source values are **not in any file on hand**. Final local disposition: a separately generated table uses an explicitly flagged, unvalidated E13 donor for supporting climate values; gradient remains NA. The executed headline occupancy formula excludes climate, flow, and gradient (`Dist_from_lake + season`), so these gaps do not block it.
